name: Property-Based Temporary Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires ownership AND actual use of Montenegrin real estate valued at least EUR 150,000, as assessed by the Tax Authority's transfer-tax evaluation (below the government's initial EUR 200,000 proposal). All property tax obligations must be settled. The residence granted is TEMPORARY (1 year, renewable) and does NOT confer the right to work or run a business in Montenegro -- it is a residence-only route, not a path to citizenship, and is a fundamentally different, smaller program than Montenegro's now-discontinued Citizenship by Investment scheme.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase and actively use qualifying Montenegrin real estate valued at EUR 150,000+, with property taxes current.

evidence_required.document: Proof of settled property tax obligations

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: actual use of the property, not merely ownership

sources.title: IMI Daily (investment-migration industry trade press) -- reports the EUR 150,000 minimum for Montenegro's property-based temporary residency (down from a proposed EUR 200,000), no work/business rights, and the 2019-2022 Citizenship by Investment programme's discontinuation at the end of 2022 under EU pressure

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to investment-migration trade press (tier 3) reporting on a government decision; Montenegro's own government portal (gov.me/psc.gov.me) almost certainly hosts the underlying regulation but the specific property-residency rule text was not located/fetched in this build. CLOSED PROGRAM, DISCLOSED RATHER THAN MODELED AS A ROUTE: Montenegro operated a genuine Citizenship by Investment scheme from 2019-2022 (EUR 450,000 or EUR 250,000 depending on location/project, plus a government donation), but it was discontinued at the end of 2022 following sustained EU pressure -- consistent with the EU's general skepticism toward 'golden passport' schemes for EU-candidate countries. No file was built for this because it is no longer an available route; per this dataset's convention, a closed program with no active applications is disclosed in notes rather than fabricated as a live route. The current property-based residency is a materially SMALLER program (temporary residence only, EUR 150,000, no work rights) -- not a replacement or successor route to the old CBI program, and this distinction is worth keeping clear rather than conflating the two.
